mapper.select: SELECT status FROM wimb.common_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND file_seq_no = #{fileSeqNo} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT F.* FROM wimb.common_file F WHERE F.status = 'DELETED' OR (F.status = 'PENDING' AND F.started_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 day') OR (F.status = 'UPLOAD_SUCCESS' AND F.uploaded_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 day') OR (F.status = 'FAIL' AND F.started_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 day')
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wimb.common_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND user_id = #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wimb.common_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND file_seq_no = #{fileSeqNo}
